newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse ends session slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse ends session slightly lower.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange on Tuesday closed 0.04 percent lower, with major stocks showing some signs of stagnation, analysts said.
The all-share index closed at 433.06 points compared with 433.23 points on Monday.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement, Morocco's second largest private conglomerate lost one dirham to close at 556 dirhams.
SNI has diversified stakes in more than 40 companies. The group has a market capitalisation of 5.5 billion dirhams, brokers said.
Samir oil firm, the country's main refinery, closed unchanged at 250 dirhams.
Wafabank, one of the liquid stocks, was unchanged at 530 dirhams.
Traded volume on the official market was 15.5 million dirhams, down from 18.6 million on Monday.
